Evidence passages from your search for "Ashley Graham plus-size model evidence":
<<<PASSAGES
[P1] Ashley Graham
Ashley Graham may refer to : Ashley Graham ( rugby league ) ( born 1984 ) , NRL player Ashley Graham ( model ) ( born 1987 ) , American plus-size model Ashley Graham ( Resident Evil ) , a fictional character in the 2005 video game Resident Evil 4

[P2] Ashley Graham (model)
Ashley Graham ( born October 30 , 1987 ) is an American model . She has appeared on the cover of fashion magazines such as Vogue , Harper 's Bazaar , Glamour , and Elle . In addition , she appeared in several Levi 's campaigns . Graham has appeared on The Tonight Show with Jay Leno , Entertainment Tonight , and CBS News and was interviewed by NPR about plus-size modeling . In 2016 , she became the first plus-size model to appear on the cover of the Sports Illustrated Swimsuit Issue . In 2017 , Graham became the first plus-size model to appear on the covers of British and American Vogue .

[P3] Plus-size model
Plus-size model is term applied to an individual of average to larger stature ( sometimes but not exclusively overweight or obese ) who is engaged primarily in modeling plus-size clothing . Plus-size models also engage in work that is not strictly related to selling large-sized clothing , e.g. , stock photography and advertising photography for cosmetics , household and pharmaceutical products and sunglasses , footwear and watches . Therefore , plus-size models do not exclusively wear garments marketed as plus-size clothing . This is especially true when participating in fashion editorials for mainstream fashion magazines . Synonymous and interchangeable with plus-size model is `` full-figured model '' , `` extended-sizes model '' , and `` outsize model '' . Previously , the term `` large size model '' was also frequently used .

[P4] Plus-size
Plus-size or plus-sized may refer to : Plus-size clothing , a general term given to clothing proportioned specifically for people around size 12 and up in the U.S. Plus-size model , a fashion model who specializes in modeling the above-mentioned clothing Plus sizing , the practice of changing a vehicle 's wheels to a larger size and reducing the size of the tires ( tyres ) to compensate

[P5] Angellika Morton
Angellika Morton began as a straight size model and transitioned to plus-size modeling in 1997 . In 1999 , she became the first model to be inducted into the International Model Hall of Fame .
